blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Benedicto College (BC) Cheetahs secured a twice-to-beat advantage in the Final Four of the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament after completing a come-from-behind 66-59 victory over the University of Cebu Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue (UCLM) Webmasters on Saturday, November 28, at the Cebu Coliseum. The victory assured the Cheetahs of their third consecutive Final Four appearance and moved them closer to finishing the elimination round on top of the standings. Benedicto improved to 12 wins against two losses with the elimination round nearing its conclusion. UCLM, meanwhile, remained at seventh place with […]...
